home.title: Mada
home.subtitle: Private conversations, thoughtful presence, and controls that stay yours. Built for clarity—not noise.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use your email or a connected account.
login.registered: Account created. You can sign in now.
login.error: Could not sign in. Check email and password. If you created this account with GitHub or Google, use that button instead.
login.suspendedNotice: This account has been suspended. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

register.description: Sign up with email and password.

appLock.screenSubtitle: Enter your 4-digit passcode or use biometrics.
appLock.biometricsUnavailable: Biometrics not available on this device
appLock.settingsHint: Protects this browser with a 4-digit code. Stored only on this device.
appLock.timeoutHint: Auto-lock after {minutes} minutes of inactivity, or immediately when you leave the tab.
appLock.disableConfirm: This removes your passcode and biometric key from this device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: Mada — secure real-time messaging. Language and appearance sync to your account when you are signed in.
settings.bioPlaceholder: Tell others a bit about you…
settings.photoHint: Uses the same secure upload pipeline as chat attachments.
settings.revokeSessionsHint: Other devices lose access within about a minute. This device refreshes your session automatically.
settings.pushHint: When off, we remove this device from push and skip registering new subscriptions.
settings.wallpaperHint: Solid color (#RRGGBB) or image URL (https… or uploaded file path).
settings.readReceiptsHint: When off, others will not see when you have read their messages.
settings.onlineStatusHint: When off, you will not appear in others' online lists while using chat.
settings.deleteWarning: This permanently deactivates your account. You will be signed out.
settings.deleteConfirmLabel: Type DELETE MY ACCOUNT to confirm
settings.oauthNoPassword: Password change is not available for accounts that only use Google or GitHub.

chat.startDmHint: Start a DM with another user's email.
chat.offlineBanner: You're offline. Recent chats on this device stay available until you reconnect.
chat.selectConversation: Select a conversation to start messaging.
chat.selectConversationHint: Open a direct chat from the sidebar to message someone.
chat.blockConfirmBody: They will not be able to contact you or see when you are online. You can unblock later from this chat.
chat.composerBlockedByPeer: You can no longer send messages to this conversation
chat.lockedChatsHint: Hidden until you unlock with your passcode or biometrics.
chat.vaultSubtitle: Use the same passcode or biometrics as app lock.
chat.catchUpBanner: Select messages, then tap Summarize for a short recap.
chat.catchUpSummarizeError: Could not generate a summary. Try again.
chat.catchUpSummarizeEmpty: The model returned an empty summary. Try different messages.
chat.lockChatVaultSubtitle: Enter your Mada Secret Space PIN to move this conversation to Locked chats.
chat.chatVaultPinSetupSubtitle: This PIN is stored only in Mada on your account, not your phone lock screen. Choose four digits.
chat.chatVaultPinConfirmSubtitle: Enter the same four digits again to confirm.
chat.chatVaultPinMismatch: PINs did not match. Start again.
chat.chatVaultPinSaveError: Could not save your PIN. Try again.
chat.changePinCurrentSubtitle: Enter your Secret Space PIN to continue.
chat.changePinNewSubtitle: Choose four digits for your new Secret Space PIN.
chat.changePinConfirmSubtitle: Enter the same four digits again to confirm.
chat.changePinWrongCurrent: That PIN is not correct. Try again.
chat.changePinMismatchToast: New PIN and confirmation did not match. Enter your new PIN again.
chat.changePinSaveError: Could not update your PIN. Try again.
chat.changePinNetworkError: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
chat.changePinSameAsOld: New PIN must be different from your current PIN.
chat.changePinSuccess: Your Secret Space PIN was updated.
chat.blockUserConfirmSimpleBody: Are you sure you want to block this user?

chatSearch.typeHint: Type a word to search message text.
chatSearch.noResultsBody: Try another keyword or switch the filter above.

messageDelete.confirmBody: This message will be removed for all people in the chat.

upload.retryNoFile: Could not retry — attach the file again.
upload.errorGeneric: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
upload.clientBadType: This file type is not supported.

voice.effectsHint: Effects are applied on your device before sending.
voice.slideToLockHint: Slide up on the mic to lock hands-free.

call.setupFailed: Could not start the call. Check that calls are configured and try again.
call.prepareBodyVoice: Mada needs your microphone for this call. When your browser asks, choose Allow. If you previously chose Block, open the site lock icon in the address bar and enable the microphone, then try again.
call.prepareBodyVideo: Mada needs your microphone and camera for this call. When your browser asks, choose Allow for both (or for Camera and Microphone). If you previously blocked access, use the site lock icon in the address bar to allow them, then try again.
call.permissionDenied: Access to the microphone or camera was blocked. Allow this site to use the microphone (and camera for video) in your browser settings, then tap Try again.
call.noDeviceFound: No microphone or camera was detected. Make sure they are connected and not used exclusively by another app.
call.mediaNotSupported: This browser cannot access the microphone from this page.
call.secureContextRequired: Calls need a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open Mada using an https:// link—for example through your normal hosted URL—not plain http.
call.permissionDismissed: Permission was not granted. When you are ready, tap Try again and choose Allow in the browser prompt.
call.hardwareBusy: The microphone or camera is busy. Close other apps or tabs that may be using them, then try again.

aiAgent.modeSuggested: Suggested — AI drafts; you send or regenerate
aiAgent.modeAutopilot: Autopilot — AI replies for you when you receive a message
aiAgent.directivePlaceholder: e.g. Keep it playful, match their energy, or be brief.
aiAgent.emptySuggest: The model returned an empty draft.
